training.title: Race day
bullets: Race: 42.2 km. Start conservatively; the first 5 km should feel almost too easy.
Use the pacing target confirmed from your final benchmark weeks - do not chase other runners early.
Fuel from early in the race using the gel/carbohydrate routine practised in long runs; sip fluids regularly.
Break the race into sections: 0-10 km settle, 10-30 km controlled, 30-37 km focus, final 5 km compete if able.
If the day is hot or you feel unexpectedly poor, protect the finish rather than forcing the original pace.

recipes.title: Lemon-garlic chicken rice bowls
method: Slice chicken and veg; toss with oil, garlic, herbs, lemon zest.
Pan-fry chicken 6-8 min until cooked through.
Serve over rice with lemon juice.

recipes.title: Beef & bean chilli with rice
method: Add tomatoes and beans; simmer 15 min.

recipes.title: Creamy tomato chicken fusilli
method: Add tomatoes and herbs; simmer 8 min.
Take off heat and stir in yogurt and spinach.

recipes.title: Teriyaki salmon rice bowls
method: Bake or pan-cook salmon, brushing with sauce.
Serve salmon and veg over rice with remaining sauce.

recipes.title: Loaded sweet potatoes with beef & yogurt
method: Add tomatoes and paprika; simmer 10 min.
Split potatoes and fill with beef.

recipes.title: Chicken pesto pasta
method: Cook pasta; add peas for final 2 min.
Pan-cook diced chicken until cooked through.
Drain pasta, reserving a splash of water.
Top lightly with cheese. Keep this meal comfortably familiar.

recipes.title: Chicken fajita wraps + rice
method: Slice chicken, pepper and onion; cook with spices.
Fill wraps with chicken mix and yogurt.
Serve rice alongside; squeeze over lime.

recipes.title: Chicken tikka rice bowls
method: Mix half the yogurt with tikka paste and coat chicken.
Pan-cook chicken and onion until done.
Serve over rice with remaining yogurt.

recipes.title: Beef meatballs, tomato fusilli & spinach
method: Add garlic and tomatoes; simmer 15 min.
Cook pasta and add spinach to sauce.
Toss together and top with cheese.

recipes.title: Honey-soy chicken noodles & broccoli
ingredients: 1 tsp garlic puree or 1 garlic clove
method: Add broccoli and carrot with a splash of water.
Stir in soy, honey and garlic.

recipes.title: Salmon, potatoes & peas traybake
ingredients: 1 tsp dried dill or mixed herbs
method: Cube potatoes; roast with a little oil for 20 min.
Add salmon and roast 12-15 min more.
Mix yogurt, lemon and herbs; serve alongside.

recipes.title: Tomato-basil spaghetti + chicken
method: Add tomatoes, puree and basil; simmer 10 min.
Add a light sprinkle of cheese; keep spice and fat low.

recipes.title: Cottage pie + peas
method: Add puree and stock; simmer 10 min.
Top with mash and cheese; bake/grill until golden.

recipes.title: Mexican chicken burrito bowls
method: Cook chicken, pepper and onion with spices.
Build bowls with rice, chicken and beans.

recipes.title: Lean beef stroganoff with rice
method: Add mushrooms and paprika; cook 6-8 min.
Remove from heat; stir in yogurt and mustard.

recipes.title: Chicken pesto pasta & peas
method: Cook pasta, adding peas for final 2 min.
Drain pasta and stir through pesto.

recipes.title: Lemon salmon pasta & peas
method: Mix yogurt, lemon zest/juice and dill off heat.

recipes.title: Garlic chicken rice bowl
method: Add carrot and peas with a splash of water.
Serve over rice. Keep this simple and familiar.

recipes.title: Beef bolognese spaghetti
method: Brown beef, onion and grated carrot.

recipes.title: Mediterranean chicken couscous bowls
method: Season chicken with herbs and cook.
Cover couscous with boiling water; stand 5 min.
Serve with chicken, veg and yogurt.

recipes.title: Chicken egg fried rice
method: Cook rice; cool slightly if possible.
Add rice, peas, carrot and chicken.
Stir-fry with soy until piping hot.

recipes.title: Salmon, sweet potato wedges & broccoli
method: Cut sweet potato into wedges; roast 25-30 min.

recipes.title: Lentil tomato pasta + feta
method: Add tomatoes, lentils and herbs; simmer 10 min.
Toss with pasta and crumble feta over.

recipes.title: Simple chicken tomato pasta
method: Add tomatoes, puree and basil; simmer 8-10 min.
Add a small amount of cheese. Keep it low-spice and familiar.

recipes.title: Mild chicken curry + rice
method: Add curry paste and pepper; cook 2 min.
Remove from heat, stir in yogurt and spinach; serve with rice.

defaultSupplements.name: Creatine monohydrate
defaultSupplements.note: Daily, including rest days. Powder is fine; timing is less important than consistency.

fuelRules.title: Long-run fuel
fuelRules.text: For sessions over ~75–90 min, practise carbohydrate intake. Start around 30–40 g/hour and build toward ~60 g/hour as tolerated. Use water/electrolytes to conditions.

fuelRules.title: Optional caffeine
fuelRules.text: If you tolerate caffeine, ~1–3 mg/kg about 45–60 min before a key/long session can be useful. Do not use it late in the day or for every run.

fuelRules.title: Post-training protein
fuelRules.text: Aim for a normal protein-rich meal. Protein powder is optional if food is not convenient; ~20–30 g protein is a practical serving.
